Interface AudioSink

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface AudioSink extends AutoCloseable
Receives interleaved, signed 16-bit little-endian PCM frames. Producers may reuse the input buffer after accept(byte[], int) returns.

  • Method Details

    • open

      static AudioSink open(int sampleRate, int channels) throws LineUnavailableException
      Opens a Java Sound output with a bounded queue and a dedicated writer thread. Playback does not block the producer; a full queue drops the newest batch.
      Parameters:
      sampleRate - frames per second
      channels - number of interleaved channels
      Returns:
      an open sink owned by the caller
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the format is invalid or unsupported
      LineUnavailableException - if no audio device can be opened

    • accept

      void accept(byte[] pcmSamples, int length)
      Accepts length valid bytes from the start of the buffer. The bytes must contain complete PCM frames. Writes after close are discarded.
      Parameters:
      pcmSamples - PCM buffer
      length - number of valid bytes

    • flushAudio

      default void flushAudio()
      Discards queued audio and flushes the host line, rather than waiting for playback.

    • close

      default void close()
      Releases output resources. Closing an output repeatedly is safe.
